{{item infobox | description = Coins are used to create high-level weapons at the [[Mystic Forge]] in [[Lion's Arch]].
Part of [[Zommoros]]'s favorite trades. | type = trophy | material type = rare | material storage = Advanced Crafting Materials | rarity = rare | id = 19976 }} [[Mystic Coin]] is a [[crafting material]] used in [[crafting]] of the [[legendary equipment]] and in various [[Mystic Forge]] [[recipe]]s, both directly and through its related crafting material [[Mystic Clover]]. == Acquisition == === Sold by === {{Sold by}} === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Skirmish reward track === {{pip reward|Gold|final=2}} {{pip reward|Diamond|final=4}} === Achievements === {{achievement list|reward=Mystic Coin|expandable=y}} === Rewarded by === * 1 to 5 from a [[Automated Tournament#Dailies|Daily Automated Tournament]] and 1 to 100 from a [[Automated Tournament#Monthly 2|Monthly Automated Tournament]]. {{rewarded by}} === Other === * Chance for 5 to 50 from [[Mystic Clover]] crafting == Used in ==

=== Recipe lists === * The Mystic Clovers needed for first generation [[legendary weapon]]s and [[Legendary back item|legendary back items]] require approximately 231 Mystic Coins to craft. * Second generation weapons and [[legendary trinket]]s require approximately 481. * Third generation weapons require approximately 114. * The Mystic Clovers needed for a set of [[legendary armor]] require approximately 273 Mystic Coins to craft. * [[/Equipment|Equipment recipes]] * [[/Feast of food|Feast of food recipes]] * [[/Armor in bulk 1|Armor in bulk recipes]] ({{rarity|fine}}) * [[/Armor in bulk 2|Armor in bulk recipes]] ({{rarity|masterwork}}) * [[/Armor in bulk 3|Armor in bulk recipes]] ({{rarity|rare}}) * [[/Armor in bulk 4|Armor in bulk recipes]] ({{rarity|exotic}}) * [[/Other|Other recipes]] ** Particularly [[Mystic Tribute]] used in second generation legendary weapons. * [[Stat changing]] === Guild upgrades === {{guild upgrade list}} == Currency for == {{Vendor query table|currency=Mystic Coin}} == Notes == * Can be used at the [[Wishing Well]]. == See also == * [[Mystic Clover]] * [[Mystic Forge/Equipment]] * [[Crafting material#Advanced crafting materials|Advanced crafting materials]] [[de:Mystische Münze]] [[es:Moneda mística]] [[fr:Pièce mystique]] [[Category:Wizard's Vault]]
